cli_args: Qwen3-4B Q4_K_M is the smoke-test model (implementation plan, decision 4), not a GRC-Bench model.

Threads fixed at 16 of the 24 cores (this Core Ultra 9 285K has 8 performance and 16 efficiency cores, one thread each), to leave cores to the other GRC-Bench workflows running on this machine; H1 laptops have 8-16 cores.
The task for this test: 4K and 16K; add 32K only if the 16K measurement takes under 3 minutes (read as the whole 16K measurement, both processes with warm-ups); 64K not requested.

Other GRC-Bench workflows shared this machine during the run. Before each llama-bench process the run waited until no other llama-server / llama-bench was running, but other CPU load was not excluded; the 1-minute load average before and after each process is recorded in the spread table.

Two earlier attempts on 18 Oct did not finish. The first was stopped during 16K because GPU-backend detection matched libggml-cpu-cannonlake.so as the CANN backend (fixed and regression-tested). The second was cut off when the machine was moved, during the 16K depth process, after its 16K prompt process had finished (five 16,384-token prompts of 701-1176 s each). Their raw files, and the second attempt's partial record, are kept in ~/grc-bench-work/tier_e/plumbing_qwen3_4b_cpu.attempt1_gpu_probe_bug and .attempt2_interrupted_machine_move. This run started again from the warm-up; the record is now saved after every llama-bench process.

protocol.contention: wait until no other llama-server/llama-bench process runs (poll 30 s, up to 60 min) before every llama-bench process; record load average
protocol.extension_rule: --extend C --extend-if-under S: C is measured only if the previous context's whole measurement (both processes, warm-ups included) took under S seconds
protocol.peak_gpu: nvidia-smi memory.used, sampled every second, peak minus the value before the process started (device-wide); n/a without a GPU backend
protocol.peak_ram: ru_maxrss of the llama-bench process from wait4 (= VmHWM at exit); max over a context's processes
protocol.source: eval plan §4.5 (median of 5 runs, warm cache, 4K-64K context); §7.1 (8-bit KV cache)
protocol.statistic: median of the per-run samples of each llama-bench test

tests_per_context.depth: llama-bench -p 512 -n 128 -d C: tg128 and pp512 with C tokens already in the KV cache
tests_per_context.prompt: llama-bench -p C -n 0 -d 0: a C-token prompt into an empty KV cache

protocol.threads: physical cores unless set; fixed for the whole run
protocol.ttft: median prefill time of the C-token prompt + one decode step at depth C (1 / median tg128 tokens/s); derived, both parts recorded
protocol.warmup: one short warm-up llama-bench invocation per run (pp512 + tg16, 1 repetition; discarded) to page the weights in, plus llama-bench's own warm-up run before every test (discarded)
